title: Just okay
text: Just okay. This is a passable coffee mug warmer. It doesn't keep my coffee quite hot enough for me, but others may find it okay. What I do like it though is that it actually does stay on and keep a constant temperature for a long time...up to 4 hours. I was a little surprised at the flimsy, plastic housing. I didn't expect that, since the plate is quite warm. It seems like it would melt, but it doesn't. There are better coffee mug warmers out there. My favorite is the Cosori.
